answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 63818 Country: India Title: Wearing totally black clothes Question: Is it allowable to wear totally black clothes (e.g. black kurta, pajama, shalwar qamis)? Please clarify me. Answer ID: 63818 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 340/340/SD=05/1437) Yes, it is lawful. However, during some special days the Shia wear black clothes in particular, so in order to avoid their resemblance during those days one should not wear black clothes like them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
